text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Last night, you see~. After I got into bed,
for some reason I couldn't sleep a wink~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They say worrying just makes it harder to sleep anyway,
so I just laid down like, "Oh well~"...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"And then, morning came just like that~.
Should I have tried to get some sleep?
*yaaawn*..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Hishi Akebono
didn't get a very good night's rest.
